sentences.text:
This criminal appeal has been filed under Section 14-A of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities) Act,
1989.

2. Appellant has been arrested in connection with Crime No.238/2024 registered at Police Station Ramnagar, District- Maihar for the offences punishable under Sections 376, 376(2)(n) and 506 of IPC and Section 3(2)(v) of SC/ST Act.
Appellant is in jail since 02.06.2024.

3. Prosecution story, in brief, is that applicant established physical relation with prosecutrix without her consent on 12.03.2024 and 04.05.2024.
4.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that date of birth of prosecutrix is 01.01.2006.
On the date of incident, prosecutrix was major.
It is urged that incident is said to have on 12.03.2024 and 04.05.2024.
FIR has been lodged on 29.05.2024.
There is delay in lodging FIR for which no explanation has been furnished.
Appellant is in jail since 02.06.2024.
After investigation, charge sheet has been filed.
It is also urged that applicant's mother is suffering from cancer disease and there is no one to look after her in his family.

There is no evidence NEUTRAL CITATION NO.
2025:MPHC-JBP:12126 2 CRA-781-2025 pertaining to any obscene video prepared by the appellant.
It is also urged that prosecutrix is not appearing before the court for recording her statement.

He Asahad Mohd vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/110472442/
1 further submits that the trial of the case will take considerable time.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Therefore, it has been prayed that the appellant be released on bail pending the trial.
5. On the other hand, learned counsel for the State has opposed grant of bail.

6. Looking to overall facts and circumstances of the case, including nature of evidence available on record with respect applicant's involvement in the offence, I am of the view that it is not a fit case for grant of bail to the appellant.

7. Therefore, this second bail application under Section 14-A of the SC/ST (Prevention of Atrocities)
Act, 1989 on behalf of appellant Asahad Mohd. stands dismissed.

(ACHAL KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE L.R.
